notes: Upstream defaults to the TypeSimple rotation, which the site builds into an APL in the browser; the defaults here use the APL preset "melee-weave" instead.

priorityList.notes: Rapid Fire at range: from the pull, or like the other cooldowns after the first 5 s.
Start of the fight, before the first weave: get to my spot without losing an Auto Shot.

actions.notes: In melee with the GCD about to come up: wait for it, so the melee key goes out before I leave.
In melee with Strider Kick about to come up: wait for it.
I swung since my last Auto Shot: walk out to my spot and shoot.
Auto Shot went off since my last swing: walk in and swing.
Walk to my spot, looking again every reaction time. Stop while my Auto Shot's windup is close or running, and react to each shot before walking on.
Standing for my Auto Shot.
